//: Two entries, once a day each — the Vercel free (Hobby) tier's limit.
Schedules are UTC. Israel is UTC+2 in winter and UTC+3 in summer, so
05:00Z lands at 07:00 or 08:00 local: inside the 07:00-11:00 window
morning_briefing self-gates on. If you move to a different timezone,
change this hour or the briefing will skip every day.
Each path is a GROUP, not a single job (see app/api/cron/[job]/route.ts):
one slot runs a producer-then-dispatcher sequence, because generating a
briefing and emailing it are deliberately separate jobs.
For genuinely timely reminders ('your event starts in 15 minutes') this
cadence is not enough — two fixed times a day cannot deliver a 15-minute
sweep on the free tier, or upgrade to Vercel Pro and add
busy_week_scan needs a weekly slot that does not fit the free tier at
all; the GitHub Actions workflow covers it.
